display.purpose: Page h1 and store hero only; tight -0.055em tracking, always Space Grotesk.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked identity lines and fact labels; earns its place only by printing required content.

narrative.overview: The product is a working grocery shelf, not a dashboard. Every store is a shelf-edge label: a white plate with hairline rules, a state tag top-left, the reason printed as the label's name, the facts as the price field, and the decision stamped in a pale-indigo zone. The visitor's eye travels the shelf like a grocer's: three groups, one polarity checked first - the magenta clearance sticker marks every store that needs a human decision. Everything else on the shelf is settled paper; live and safe states stay quiet by design. Color never decorates: indigo carries all shell ink, green carries only the live-data system, magenta is spent only on the act-now polarity. Depth is settled paper on paper, and the one authored motion is the topline sweep, the shelf powering on while the feed wakes.
keyCharacteristics: One signature moment per surface: the die-cut magenta clearance sticker (rotated -1.4deg) on needs-intervention rows.
Hairline (1px #d7e2df) rules structure every plate; no card wears a colored border above 1px on any side.
Words print only in deepened inks (#0e7a55, #a4285e); the raw brand trio appears only in non-text positions.
All live figures are Space Grotesk with tabular-nums; Roboto carries the body.
The state system is a triad, never a rainbow: act-now (magenta), no-signal (slate), settled (green).

rules.name: The Clearance-Sticker Rule
rules.body: #cf348d appears only where the meaning is "act now" - the die-cut sticker, its plate count, its tab. A screen with zero needs-intervention stores contains zero magenta. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Deep-Ink Rule
rules.body: Words never print in the raw brand trio on light ground; green words print #0e7a55, magenta words print #a4285e. The raw trio is for dots, bars, sweeps, and fills.

rules.name: The Edge Rule
rules.body: No card container carries a colored border above 1px on any side (including painted pseudo-element stripes). State color enters through backgrounds, tags, counts, and the sticker - never through card edges.

rules.name: The One Polarity Rule
rules.body: Magenta names the only urgent state. Degraded-but-not-urgent wears amber; missing-signal wears slate; nothing else competes for the red-family voice except guard-critical chips.

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: Every live figure - counts, percentages, timestamps, store IDs - is Space Grotesk with tabular-nums, because the board re-renders every 60s and proportional digits jitter as they change.

rules.name: The Settled-Paper Rule
rules.body: Shadows are ambient and always layered rgba-indigo, never hard-offset; the shelf is calm, state changes are the only drama.

dos: Do reserve #cf348d for act-now moments only; if a screen has no urgent store, it has no magenta.
Do print green and magenta words in the deep inks (#0e7a55, #a4285e) - the raw duo only for dots, bars, sweeps, fills.
Do set every live figure in Space Grotesk tabular-nums.
Do rotate exactly one element - the clearance sticker at -1.4deg - and stand it back up at narrow widths.
Do keep plate rules at 1px Hairline and radius at 6px/4px.
donts: Don't put a colored border (or painted stripe) thicker than 1px on any card edge; state rides backgrounds, tabs, counts, and stickers.
Don't add glass, blur, or floating pills to the brand band; it is sealed flat with the 2px indigo edge.
Don't introduce a second urgent color family (no orange alerts competing with the clearance magenta; amber is for degraded guards only).
Don't rotate anything else or exceed -1.4deg; one sticker per row is the whole show.
Don't use decorative kickers or icon+title+text dashboard cards; content lines earn their uppercase tracking only by carrying campaign/freshness truth.
